scope: Initial selected G1-G4 contract checks with isolated defect demonstrations; not full refactor acceptance.

checks.contract: Existing TOON golden, JSON parseability, nonzero usage exit, exactly one JSON error document, and flag precedence. JSON parseability is not an exact key-set assertion.
Exact compact and full TOON projections, including field omission.
Fake native HTTP delete/write counts, plan/prewrite hierarchy phases, changed source refusal, and managed policy preview behavior.
Preview performs one resolution and no writes; changed authoritative LUID prevents deletion.
HTTP success with unchanged requested attributes is not full success. Preserve partial/unknown outcomes, confirmed identity, request ID, and failed field.
Real test-owned config plus fake credential store state; compensation and preview effects. Does not establish OS keyring or Unix durability-failure behavior.

A failed credential deletion with a restored but not durable reference reports persistence phase and unknown outcome, directs inspection of both stores, and does not claim an orphan. The Windows app.Run fixture separately exercises the pre-replacement orphan path.

After failed external commit, a restore replacement failure leaves the updated config in effect; a post-replacement sync failure installs the prior config with uncertain durability. Both errors preserve the external failure.
